title: Reported Cases of Child and Elder Abuse in Last Five Years
what_it_is: Reported Cases of Child and Elder Abuse in Last Five Years

sections.label: Elder and child abuse cases
sections.summary: MSF investigated an average of 78 elder abuse cases yearly since 2015, most abuse involves family perpetrators, and the Vulnerable Adults Act took effect in December 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Since the Adult Protective Service was set up in 2015, MSF has investigated an average of 78 cases annually involving elders above the age of 65.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The majority of both our child and elder abuse cases involve physical abuse or neglect.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Close to 90% of perpetrators in child abuse cases investigated by MSF are family members involving a parent or stepparent.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For elder abuse, 80% of perpetrators are the victims' family members, including children and spouses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Vulnerable Adults Act, which came into effect on 19 December 2018, provides an additional lever to protect vulnerable adults when families and community partners are unable to do so.

sections.label: Family and community prevention
sections.summary: The family and community are the frontline for prevention, and recovery for those who came forward has been good though slow for some.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, the family, community, they are the frontline, where we can help to prevent it from happening.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So far, those who have come forward, that we have been in touch with, we have seen that the recovery process has been quite good although not easy, and, for some, quite slow.

sections.label: MSF Break The Silence videos
sections.summary: MSF's "Break The Silence" awareness campaign videos have been quite successful.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Our awareness campaigns, for example, MSF's "Break The Silence" videos have been quite successful.

sections.label: Heartlands outreach in 2018
sections.summary: In 2018, about 35,000 persons in the heartlands were reached to equip themselves to address the issues.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Last year, in 2018, we reached out to about 35,000 persons in the heartlands to equip themselves to be able to address the issues.
